Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| **Baan Thai** | 2000 W. 18th St. (Logan Square) | Pad See Ew (veggie), Red Curry (veggie), Veggie Satay Skewers. |
| **Mango Tree** | 400 S. Wabash Ave. (River North) | Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu in Coconut Milk, Fresh Spring Rolls. |
| **Lanna Thai** | 5000 N. Lincoln Park (Lincoln Park) | Vegetarian Green Curry, Tofu Pad Thai, Veggie Dumplings. |
